lessons_learned: Google Fonts 被墙时，自托管字体 + CanvasKit 渲染器 + nginx 自定义路径是唯一可靠方案
视频下载页面重构为页签模式（下载中/已完成/失败）+ 批量选择模式显著提升 UX
孩子端视频观看需要独立入口卡片（child_home_screen）+ 专用视频列表页面
Puppeteer 集成时，extractDouyinInfo 和 performDouyinDownload 需要 headless Chromium 环境
bookId/bookTitle context must be passed from Flutter AI chat screen through SSE to backend agent executor for context-aware responses — verified with 17 unit tests (3 test files, 70 tests total)
book-to-skill system requires a multi-layer architecture: upload (Flutter) → extract (Python script) → store (NestJS BookSkill entity) → query (AI agent tool)
nginx client_max_body_size must be set for file uploads >1MB, otherwise 502 Bad Gateway
Flutter Web FileReader via dart:html is the only reliable way to read file contents on Web (file_picker path is null on Web)
ApiService should be a singleton from Provider, not a new instance — otherwise token injection fails and 401
TypeScript any→unknown is a safe migration that doesn't break builds
Dart withOpacity→withValues is a non-breaking deprecation migration
Flutter Web build with ProxyProvider requires careful DI — ApiService injected via Provider.of() must be the same instance as the one used for SSE streams
The nginx ^~ /uploads/ modifier is critical to prevent regex location ~* \.(png|jpg|js)$ from intercepting proxy_pass
Flutter Web expects JWT in URL query params for media elements (video/audio) — headers don't work on Web
Backend validation in constructor runs before onModuleInit — always use OnApplicationBootstrap for post-registration validation
Child accounts with empty password cannot login via password — loginCode is the only valid auth method
Remember Me must distinguish page-refresh (always persist token) vs browser-reopen (persist user info only when checked)
Remotion CLI entry point is remotion-cli.js, not dist/index.js — the latter exports but never calls cli()
CJK font resolution must check both Windows and Linux paths with fc-match fallback
npx fails for locally-installed CLI tools — always check node_modules directly
flutter_bootstrap.js versioning needs TWO sed passes: one for versioned refs, one for quoted bare "main.dart.js"
Flutter Web initialRoute must be set to '/' to prevent browser URL path from shadowing Provider-based home
Token restoration from SharedPreferences must be synchronous — Timer delays cause 401 race conditions on refresh
IconPicker edit badge must be proportionally sized and positioned half-in/half-out to avoid occluding emoji
